Renewal

This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least one hundred and twenty (120) days prior to the end of the then-current term.

Confidentiality

Each party shall protect the Confidential Information of the other party with no less than reasonable care, and these obligations shall survive for three (3) years following termination.
Vendor may appoint Sub-processors and shall publish an updated list on its website.

Governing Law and Dispute Resolution

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, USA, without regard to its conflict of laws principles, and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Delaware.

Indemnification

Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer against any third party claim alleging that the Services infringe any intellectual property right, and against any claim arising from Vendor's breach of its security or data protection obligations.

Intellectual Property

Vendor shall own all Deliverables and all data derived from Customer's use of the Services.

Limitation of Liability

Except for the Excluded Claims, the aggregate liability of either party arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 500,000.

Fees and Payment

Customer shall pay all invoiced amounts within ten (10) days of the invoice date.
Service credits shall be Customer's sole and exclusive remedy for any failure to meet any availability target.

Term and Termination

Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' prior written notice, and Vendor shall refund prepaid unused fees.
